Elaine (People Ops): @channel Quick heads-up — all-hands this Thursday 10:00am PT. Please read the short pre-brief below and drop any Qs in-thread or add to the shared doc. Recording will be posted afterward. :calendar: 

Elaine (People Ops): Agenda (30m total):
```
1) Exec update (Raj) — 10m
2) Launch callouts + rollout plan (Maria) — 7m
3) New internal Fairness & Privacy Playbook summary (Derek) — 7m
4) Q&A + shoutouts — 6m
```

Raj (CEO): Quick note — I’ll cover top-level strategy + growth milestones, and we’ll announce the Dedicated capacity partnerships. Keep questions concrete so we can triage to owners.

Maria (Product): We’ll show the Canary rollout dashboard and the new per-route cost insights in Console. If you have specific metrics you want highlighted, post them here (e.g., 99th p50 latency for chat).

Derek (Eng): Summary of the playbook we’ll present: changes to data retention defaults (90 -> 30 days for debug logs), new mandatory eval checks for model rollouts, and guidelines on safe-fallback model mappings. TL;DR: fewer retained logs, stronger eval gates.

Sam (Comms): Logistics: livestream link is in the calendar invite. If you can’t attend live, add "Watch later" to the doc and we’ll pin the recording + timestamped highlights. I’ll post the recording in this thread within 2 hours post-call.

Elaine (People Ops): How to submit Qs: add them as replies here, or append to the Q&A doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/allhands/questions (use the template at the top). We’ll prioritize questions by votes and by product/eng owner.

Maria (Product): Quick ask to PMs/engineers: if you want a 2-min demo slot, reply with "Demo: <team> - <topic>". We can fit two tiny demos if they’re tightly focused.

Derek (Eng): Volunteers to demo the new canary dashboard? @Jina, @Carlos — any chance you can prep a 90s walkthrough?

Elaine (People Ops): For remote folks — please enable captions in Zoom and add any accessibility notes in the doc. We’ll also post a short transcript alongside the recording.

Raj (CEO): One more: we’ll announce a small org restructure to better align infra teams around Dedicated and Private. Not firing — just moving ownership. More details in the exec update.

Sam (Comms): Post-call artifacts planned: recording (<=2h), 3-minute highlight clip (<=24h), thread with decisions & owners. If you need embargoed details, DM me before the all-hands.

Elaine (People Ops): ACTIONS before Thu 10am PT: add Qs here or in doc, tag any demos, and please react :thumbsup: if you plan to attend live.

Derek (Eng): Small excerpt of the playbook we’ll surface in the slide deck — please skim if you touch model serving or logging: 
```
- Retention: debug logs default -> 30 days (opt-in 90d)
- Rollout gate: automated evals + manual approval for model major versions
- Fallbacks: define compatible quantized variant, region-based fallback order
```

Maria (Product): For PMs: bring one metric you care about for your route (cost/token, p95 latency, or error rate). We’ll use them to demonstrate the Console panels.

Elaine (People Ops): Reminder: AllHandsBot will ping 10m before start. If you don’t want pings, set your calendar status to busy.

AllHandsBot: Recording will be posted here after the meeting. 

Sam (Comms): Minor ask — if your team has a customer-facing highlight (e.g., big customer launch on Dedicated), DM me a 2-line blurb and a screenshot. We may include it in the highlight clip.

Raj (CEO): Appreciate everyone prepping. Let’s keep the meeting tight — we want clear decisions and owners.

Elaine (People Ops): Last call for questions and demos. I’ll close the QnA doc at 9:45am PT to give folks time to triage. 

Maria (Product): Post-meeting followups I expect to publish: rollout timeline, owners for the Fairness & Privacy Playbook rollout, and any changes to release checklists.

Derek (Eng): Takeaway for engineers: read the playbook before the all-hands if you touch logging or model routing. We’ll need feedback by EOD next Tues to iterate.

Sam (Comms): I’ll drop the recording link here after the call and pin the thread. Thanks all. :clap:
